scope: real counterexamples observed while building the acceptance matrix; retained, not hidden. This is the corrected copy: the previous round's coverage claims were inaccurate and are fixed here. The original file under acceptance-coverage-20261111T070145Z/ retains historical meaning.

cases.sql: SELECT NULL IS NULL, NULL = NULL, COALESCE(NULL, 1), COUNT(value), COUNT(*), SUM(opt), total(opt) FROM vals

observed.message: SQLite accepts this read-only syntax but the AST adapter does not yet implement it

cases.interpretation: total() is a real unsupported feature. The error is correctly separated from syntax/binding errors (UnsupportedQuery, not InvalidArgument) and the concrete reason is retained. This is a coverage gap in the aggregate function set, not a misclassification.
cases.effect_on_acceptance: Acceptance item 2 requires aggregation to be verified per dialect; total() is not implemented and is not claimed. SUM/COUNT/MIN/MAX are covered.

cases.sqlite_oracle: returns 1 (prefix parse; verified with Python sqlite3 3.53.1 and rusqlite 3.53.2)
cases.legacy_dialects: DexSql010/DexSql011 return 1 via sqlite_integer_prefix, matching SQLite
cases.interpretation: NativeV1 deliberately requires an exact integer text and rejects a fractional prefix; legacy dialects reproduce SQLite's prefix parse. This is a documented dialect policy, not a silent wrong answer, but it is a real divergence from the SQLite oracle for NativeV1.
cases.effect_on_acceptance: The shared feature matrix excludes text-to-integer CAST for this reason. NativeV1's exact-text policy is covered by the dedicated test native_v1_integer_cast_requires_exact_text_and_diverges_from_sqlite_prefix (rejects '1.9'/'-5.9'/'1e5'/'abc' with INVALID_INTEGER_CAST, accepts '12'); legacy prefix parsing is covered by legacy_integer_cast_matches_sqlite_prefix_and_saturation_without_lossy_text. The older cast-replay artifact covers A0/A1 only and is not counted as NativeV1 coverage.
cases.correction: Previous claim that legacy_integer_cast_... and cast-replay covered both policies was false: the former only iterates DexSql010/DexSql011, and cast-replay only runs A0/A1. NativeV1 CAST('1.9' AS INTEGER) had zero coverage before this round.

cases.legacy_dialects: DexSql010/DexSql011 return 0 via sqlite_integer_prefix, matching SQLite
cases.interpretation: Same documented NativeV1 exact-cast policy as the fractional case.
cases.effect_on_acceptance: Recorded so the NativeV1/SQLite divergence is explicit rather than implied by a green matrix. Covered by native_v1_integer_cast_requires_exact_text_and_diverges_from_sqlite_prefix.
